decision_clause: The active decision rules out “retrying on a bare 403” because many such responses are permission errors that waiting cannot fix; its scope includes the collection and rate-limit code and tests.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The collector rejects pages below 1 and per-page counts outside 1–100 before contacting the transport. A 403 without rate-limit evidence is reported as a permissions failure without waiting or retrying; retry occurs only when headers identify the response as rate-limited.
rationale: The finished change only adds pre-request paging validation and corresponding tests. It neither introduces nor enables retries for bare 403 responses, and the existing scoped behavior explicitly keeps those responses on the non-retry path.
